name: Equation Escape
summary:
This VR game lets players solve math puzzles by combining numbers. Players grab floating numbers using their hands and combine them using operations like addition (+), subtraction (−), multiplication (×), or division (÷).

To switch between operations, players touch a special floating ball. The goal is simple: use the available numbers to reach the target number shown in the game.

It’s an interactive and fun way to practice math skills in virtual reality!
